verdict.rationale: The GitHub repo jina-ai/reader is public, and it explicitly refers to an "open-source branch" that is published as a prebuilt container image, so the source is readable. However, the pack never names the license. The "open-source branch" wording plus SaaS-only features such as the hosted proxy pool suggest the open code may not match the production service. missing for 10: named open-source license (e.g. Apache/MIT), confirmation that the open branch matches the hosted Reader, independent corroboration of license terms.
